rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００９Oh?￥You're just getting dinner now?＝＠１９３＿０１０I'm eating with Eiji and the￥others. Want to join us?
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１２This makes me kinda happy.＝＠１９３＿０１３With you here, even the awful￥food in this place might￥taste good.
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１４No? I won't force you, but I'd￥like to look at your face while￥I eat.
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１５Food just tastes better when￥you've got someone cute to look￥at, right?
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１６Oh... do you not like it when￥I say stuff like this?
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１７Then what's the problem?￥Here... just grab any open seat￥over there.
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０１８Really?￥Sorry for being pushy.＝＠１９３＿０１９But I really wanted to eat￥with you.
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿０２３Oh, don't worry about it.＝＠１９３＿０２４I gave those two the pudding￥I didn't finish earlier.＝＠１９３＿０２５Turns out they both love it, so￥now they're fighting over it...
＊Eiji＊＠１９３＿０２６He gave it to me!￥No calling dibs after the fact!
＊Amane＊＠１９３＿０２７Yoh never said he was giving￥it to you, Eiji!＝＠１９３＿０２８Right, Yoh? Tell him!
＊Eiji＊＠１９３＿０３１But I grabbed it first,￥so it's my pudding!
＊Amane＊＠１９４＿００１No way!￥I want it all to myself!
＊Eiji＊＠１９４＿００２Now I'm eating it out of￥sheer spite!
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０１０You're sweet, you know.￥You could've just let them be...
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０１６You've got pudding all over your￥face and hair... Rough luck...
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０２０Oh man,￥you got caught in the crossfire.
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０２１Ugh! I got pudding on me too...
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０２２Tell me about it.￥Anyway, I've gotta wash my hair.
＊Yoh＊＠１９４＿０２３I get why you're mad, but...＝＠１９４＿０２４Shouldn't you wash your hair and￥face and change first?￥You're all sticky...
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００２Who knew one pudding could￥start a fight like that?
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００３But hey, thanks to them, you￥and I get to bare it all￥together. So I'm grateful~
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００４I mean, if you get to see￥someone cute naked, even another￥guy, don't you feel kinda lucky?
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００５What, you mean you didn't￥know? That I'm...＝...＝＠１９５＿００８Heh, just kidding.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００９I just mean a cute face is easy￥on the eyes, guy or girl.＝＠１９５＿０１０So?￥Is the pudding off yet?
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０１２Today taught you a lesson, huh?＝＠１９５＿０１３It's better not to stick your￥nose into other people's fights.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０１４Butting in and getting caught￥in the crossfire is just dumb.＝＠１９５＿０１５Watching from a safe distance is￥way more fun than getting￥involved, don't you think?
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０１６Next time we eat together, I'd￥like it to be a bit calmer.＝＠１９５＿０１７Well, see you.￥Thanks for the eye candy.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２１Oh man, that's what you get￥for butting in...
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２２Why do I have to get pudding￥dumped on my head...￥Ugh! So sticky...＝＠１９５＿０２３Your hands are dirty too, huh?￥Oh well. I'm going to go take￥a shower.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２４Then let's walk part of the￥way together.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２５This is the worst... Hey, could￥you at least walk with me to the￥shower room?＝＠１９５＿０２６Walking around alone looking￥like this is way too lame.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２７Man, what a nightmare.￥Who knew one pudding could￥start a fight like that?
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０２８But thanks to them, I get to be￥alone with you. So maybe I'll￥forgive them.
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿０３０Oh! I'll wash up real quick,￥so wait for me a sec~
＊Yoh＊＠１９５＿００７Oh, I'll wash up real quick,￥so wait for me a little bit~
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿００１Phew, finally got it off...￥Thanks for waiting for me.
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿００２It just wouldn't come off.￥What a pain.＝＠１９６＿００３Guess you really shouldn't butt￥into fights, huh?
＊Yoh＊＠１９６＿００４Butting in and getting caught￥in the crossfire like today?￥Just dumb.＝＠１９６＿００５Watching from a safe distance is￥way better than getting￥involved. Trust me.
